```{r}
#Division2 - All dorsal/late neurons (All obvious dILA/B and dI4)
DefaultAssay(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late) <- "RNA"
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late <- NormalizeData(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late <- FindVariableFeatures(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late[["percent.mt.neurdl"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late, pattern = "^mt-")
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late <- ScaleData(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late, vars.to.regress = c("percent.mt.neurdl", "nCount_RNA"))
DefaultAssay(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late) <- "integrated"
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late <- RunPCA(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late, features = VariableFeatures(object = Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late), npcs = 300)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late, dims = 16:30, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
```

```{r}
Cervthorlumb_neurons <- SetIdent(Cervthorlumb_neurons, value = "subneurontypes")

#dILB2-4
Cervthorlumb_neurons <- SetIdent(Cervthorlumb_neurons, value = "subneurontypes")
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- subset(Cervthorlumb_neurons, idents = c("dILB2", "dILB3", "dILB4-A", "dILB4-B", "dILB4-C", "dILB2-A1", "dILB2-A2", "dILB2-A3"))
#Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- SetIdent(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, value = "timepoint")
#Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- subset(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, idents = c("E16"))
DefaultAssay(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234) <- "RNA"
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- NormalizeData(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- FindVariableFeatures(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, pattern = "^mt-")
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- ScaleData(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, vars.to.regress = c("percent.mt", "nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"))
DefaultAssay(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234) <- "integrated"
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- RunPCA(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, features = VariableFeatures(object = Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234), npcs = 180)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, dims = 16:30, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, dims = 31:45, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, dims = 46:60, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, dims = 61:75, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, dims = 76:90, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
ElbowPlot(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, ndims = 90)
DefaultAssay(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234) <- "integrated"
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- FindNeighbors(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:180)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, resolution = 0.5)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, resolution = 1)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, resolution = 2)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, resolution = 4)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, resolution = 8)

#dILB4-5
Cervthorlumb_neurons <- SetIdent(Cervthorlumb_neurons, value = "subneurontypes")
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45 <- subset(Cervthorlumb_neurons, idents = c("dILB3-D", "dILB4-A", "dILB4-B", "dILB4-C", "dILB5", "dILB6-A1"))
#Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- SetIdent(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, value = "timepoint")
#Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234 <- subset(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_234, idents = c("E16"))
DefaultAssay(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45) <- "RNA"
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45 <- NormalizeData(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45 <- FindVariableFeatures(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, pattern = "^mt-")
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45 <- ScaleData(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, vars.to.regress = c("percent.mt", "nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"))
DefaultAssay(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45) <- "integrated"
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45 <- RunPCA(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, features = VariableFeatures(object = Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45), npcs = 180)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, dims = 16:30, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, dims = 31:45, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, dims = 46:60, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, dims = 61:75, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, dims = 76:90, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
ElbowPlot(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, ndims = 90)
DefaultAssay(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45) <- "integrated"
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45 <- FindNeighbors(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:120)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, resolution = 0.5)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, resolution = 1)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, resolution = 2)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, resolution = 4)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, resolution = 8)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45 <- RunUMAP(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:120)
DimPlot(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, reduction = "umap", group.by = "integrated_snn_res.0.5", label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, reduction = "umap", group.by = "integrated_snn_res.1", label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, reduction = "umap", group.by = "integrated_snn_res.2", label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, reduction = "umap", group.by = "integrated_snn_res.4", label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, reduction = "umap", group.by = "integrated_snn_res.8", label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, reduction = "umap", group.by = "segment", label = T)
DimPlot(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, reduction = "umap", group.by = "timepoint", label = T)
DimPlot(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_45, reduction = "umap", group.by = "subneurontypes", label = T)

#dILB6
Cervthorlumb_neurons <- SetIdent(Cervthorlumb_neurons, value = "subneurontypes")
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6 <- subset(Cervthorlumb_neurons, idents = c("dILB-Immature", "dILB5-B2", "dILB6-A1", "dILB6-A2", "dILB6-A3", "dILB6-B1", "dILB6-B2", "dILB6-B3", "dILB6-C1", "dILB6-C2", "dILB6-C3", "dILB6-C3-Lumb"))

DefaultAssay(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6) <- "RNA"
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6 <- NormalizeData(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6 <- FindVariableFeatures(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, pattern = "^mt-")
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6 <- ScaleData(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, vars.to.regress = c("percent.mt", "nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"))
DefaultAssay(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6) <- "integrated"
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6 <- RunPCA(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, features = VariableFeatures(object = Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6), npcs = 180)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, dims = 16:30, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, dims = 31:45, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, dims = 46:60, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, dims = 61:75, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, dims = 76:90, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
ElbowPlot(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, ndims = 90)
DefaultAssay(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6) <- "integrated"
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6 <- FindNeighbors(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:90)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, resolution = 0.5)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, resolution = 1)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, resolution = 2)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, resolution = 4)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6 <- FindClusters(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, resolution = 8)
Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6 <- RunUMAP(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:90)
DimPlot(Cervthorlumb_dorsal_late_B6, reduction = "umap", group.by = "integrated_snn_res.0.5", label = T)+NoLegend()
```
